Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: transparent photographic editorial collage, concept B for a mortgage calculator card on the Kvadrat real-estate website. This is a standalone raster image asset, NOT a UI, NOT a banner with text.
Primary request: create an exceptionally polished, carefully art-directed multi-layer photographic composition about a young woman calmly planning the purchase of her home. The intended visual quality is a bespoke real-estate campaign, with the small details and overlapping depth of an expert advertising photomontage.
Subject: an entirely fictional adult woman around thirty with natural medium-brown hair, light neutral everyday business-casual clothing, an ivory textured blouse with loosely rolled sleeves, no jewelry beyond tiny earrings, realistic natural skin, quietly engaged expression. A three-quarter waist-up portrait near the center-left: she looks down at a document she is considering, one hand holds a page and the other is naturally near a small physical ivory calculator at the foreground. She is a prospective home buyer, not a posed company employee or bank representative.
Supporting details: at the bottom foreground an unbranded ivory calculator with dark graphite keys and one restrained cyan accent key, a couple of subtly layered floor-plan papers with fine architectural lines but no readable writing, and realistic silver apartment keys on a plain ring. On the right behind the woman, a beautifully detailed fragment of a contemporary residential building: warm brick and light stone, balcony depth, delicate metal railings, window reflections and a small amount of greenery. The architectural silhouette should step down into the composition and end naturally without a rectangular photo edge.
Brand motif: behind the woman's left shoulder a large clean cyan parallelogram / diamond plane inspired by a real-estate geometric logo, slightly translucent with a refined glass-like edge; a smaller graphite geometric plane behind the building. These are restrained intentional graphic planes, never a logo or readable mark. The cyan shape and architecture visibly overlap behind the human figure, creating a clear hierarchy.
Composition/framing: landscape approximately 3:2 or 1.7:1, full isolated cutout with genuine transparent alpha around the whole composition, fine clean edges, all head, hands, calculator and keys fully within the canvas with 5% safe margin. The waist, papers and a very thin implied tabletop merge into one carefully arranged organic silhouette at the bottom, with delicate contact shadows fading completely into transparency. Woman is about 55% of composition height; architecture and geometry provide wider lateral detail, foreground calculator remains identifiable at a small website display size. Photographic perspective and unified daylight make all parts feel coherent. Do not leave large unused empty space inside the scene.
Lighting/mood: gentle directional daylight from upper left, calm and thoughtful, subtle dimensional shadows, realistic microcontrast, premium editorial detail, no excessive studio glamour.
Color palette: ivory, warm neutral stone, graphite #252C2F, restrained sky cyan #57C4ED, naturally muted green leaves. The resulting cutout will sit on a pale sage #EDF0E9 website card.
Materials/textures: fine blouse weave and natural folds, individual hair strands, matte calculator plastic, brushed silver keys, paper thickness, brick grain, glazed window reflections.
Text: no text anywhere, no captions, no words, no logos, no watermark. Calculator may have ordinary digits and arithmetic symbols on the keys, display a single zero.
Avoid: no interest rates, no percentages, no banknotes or coins, no extra people, no handshake, no identity copied from an existing reference, no oversmiling stock-photo pose, no cartoon, no illustration, no plastic skin, no extra fingers, no floating disconnected stickers, no opaque background, no white rectangle, no gray backdrop, no checkerboard texture.
